standard.summary: Newbie 工作流的预设名称。当前只是登记在配置里的一个字符串，后端还没有把它展开成实际参数。
standard.effect: 会原样写进 run config 与产物清单，方便外部工具识别；训练行为不随它改变。
standard.whenToUse: 需要让外部流程知道你用的是哪套 Newbie 配方时填。
standard.avoidWhen: 指望它自动填充推荐参数——这一点尚未实现，参数仍要自己填。真要改最优化器相关配置，用 optimizer_preset。

optionDescriptions.quick_lora: 快速试跑用的名字标签。
optionDescriptions.character_lora: 角色 LoRA 用的名字标签。
optionDescriptions.style_lora: 风格 LoRA 用的名字标签。
optionDescriptions.custom: 自定义配方的名字标签。

standard_en.summary: Preset name for the Newbie workflow. As it stands this is a string recorded in the config; the backend does not expand it into actual parameters yet.
standard_en.effect: It is written verbatim into the run config and artifact manifest so external tools can recognise it; training behaviour does not change with it.
standard_en.whenToUse: When an external pipeline needs to know which Newbie recipe you used.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Expecting it to auto-fill recommended parameters -- that is not implemented and the values still have to be filled in. To change optimizer-related settings use optimizer_preset.

optionDescriptions.quick_lora: A name tag for quick trial runs.
optionDescriptions.character_lora: A name tag for character LoRAs.
optionDescriptions.style_lora: A name tag for style LoRAs.
optionDescriptions.custom: A name tag for your own recipe.

advanced.principle: 字段声明在 configs_base 上并注明「general preset name for newbie workflow」。全仓没有训练期读取点：trainer 侧的 preset 读取只出现在 block_weight 与 lycoris_preset 两条无关路径上，training_service.list_presets() 也是空实现。
advanced.intervention: 无。当前只有写入，没有消费。
advanced.expectedImpact: 零。选任何档位训练行为都一样。
advanced.tradeoffs: 这是一处「表单说有、后端没做」的缺口：文案不能宣称自动填充推荐参数。要么补上展开逻辑，要么把选项与描述改掉。

advanced_en.principle: The field is declared on configs_base with the note "general preset name for newbie workflow". Nothing reads it during training: the trainer's preset reads appear only on the unrelated block_weight and lycoris_preset paths, and training_service.list_presets() is a stub returning an empty list.
advanced_en.intervention: None. Currently write-only, with no consumer.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Zero. Training behaves identically whichever option is chosen.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: This is a "the form claims it, the backend does not do it" gap: the copy must not promise that it auto-fills recommended parameters. Either implement the expansion or change the options and description.
